question_text:
A cubic ferrite Fe₃O₄ has unit‐cell volume Vcell=5.86×10⁻²⁸ m³ and saturation magnetization M₀=5.1×10⁵ A/m.  The cell contains 8 Fe²⁺ ions (4 μB each) and 8 Fe³⁺ ions (5 μB each), arranged so that the net moment per cell is 32 μB.  We wish to raise M to 5.5×10⁵ A/m by replacing a fraction x of the Fe²⁺ ions by Mn²⁺ (5 μB each).  How large must x be?  [Take μB=9.274×10⁻²⁴ A·m².]

Refer to Table:
\begin{tabular}{lccc}
\hline TABLE 20-7 & Magnetic moments for ions in the spinel structure \\
\hline Ion & Bohr Magnetons & Ion & Bohr Magnetons \\
\hline $\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}$ & 5 & $\mathrm{Co}^{2+}$ & 3 \\
$\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}$ & 5 & $\mathrm{Ni}^{2+}$ & 2 \\
$\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}$ & 4 & $\mathrm{Cu}^{2+}$ & 1 \\
& & $\mathrm{Zn}^{2+}$ & 0 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
response:
## Step-by-Step Solution

**Given information:**
- Unit cell volume: $V_{\text{cell}} = 5.86 \times 10^{-28}\ \text{m}^3$
- Current saturation magnetization: $M_0 = 5.1 \times 10^5\ \text{A/m}$
- Net moment per cell: $32\ \mu_B$ (from 8 Fe²⁺ at 4 μB and 8 Fe³⁺ at 5 μB, antiparallel arrangement)
- Target magnetization: $M = 5.5 \times 10^5\ \text{A/m}$
- $\mu_B = 9.274 \times 10^{-24}\ \text{A·m}^2$

**Key relationship:**

$$M = \frac{\text{net magnetic moment per unit cell}}{V_{\text{cell}}}$$

**Effect of substitution:**

Each Fe²⁺ ion replaced by Mn²⁺ changes the moment from $4\mu_B$ to $5\mu_B$ — a gain of $1\mu_B$ per ion.

There are 8 Fe²⁺ ions per cell. Replacing a fraction $x$ means $8x$ ions are replaced.

**New net moment per cell:**

$$\text{Moment}_{\text{new}} = 32\mu_B + 8x(5 - 4)\mu_B = (32 + 8x)\mu_B$$

**Solve for x:**

$$M = \frac{(32 + 8x)\,\mu_B}{V_{\text{cell}}} = 5.5 \times 10^5$$

$$32 + 8x = \frac{5.5 \times 10^5 \times V_{\text{cell}}}{\mu_B} = \frac{5.5 \times 10^5 \times 5.86 \times 10^{-28}}{9.274 \times 10^{-24}} = 34.753$$

$$8x = 34.753 - 32 = 2.753$$

$$x = \frac{2.753}{8} \approx 0.344$$

**Verification:** With $x = 0.344$, the new moment is $(32 + 8 \times 0.344)\mu_B = 34.75\\mu_B$, giving $M = 34.75 \times 9.274 \times 10^{-24} / 5.86 \times 10^{-28} = 5.50 \times 10^5\ \text{A/m}$ ✓

$$\boxed{0.344}$$
